title: Bullet Resistant (Gear) — actual stuff
t: Bullet Resistant (Gear) — actual stuff
description: Actual-stuff edition — Bullet Resistant (Gear) — actual stuff. Tracks: Disc One · Bullet Resistant (Gear). Actual stuff: 20 to 35 layers of woven para-aramid (Kevlar/Twaron, ~3.6 GPa tensile) or UHMWPE (Dyneema, 0.97 g/cm3) for NIJ IIIA; ceramic strike faces (alumina, silicon carbide) bonded to composite backers for Level III/IV rifle plates. A 9 mm 124-grain round at 360 m/s carries ~518 joules; the vest earns its rating by spreading that energy across the cone of engaged yarns, keeping clay deformation under 44 mm.

title: Flame Resistant (Gear) — actual stuff

description: Actual-stuff edition — Flame Resistant (Gear) — actual stuff. Tracks: Disc One · Flame Resistant (Gear). title: Coolant Wear + Heat Wear (Systems) — actual stuff
t: Coolant Wear + Heat Wear (Systems) — actual stuff
description: Actual-stuff edition — Coolant Wear + Heat Wear (Systems) — actual stuff. Tracks: Disc One · Coolant Wear (System) / Heat Wear (System). Actual stuff: phase-change vests (paraffin/Glauber salt, 150-200 kJ/kg latent heat, melt near 15-28 C) for 1-3 hour cooling, and NASA-heritage liquid cooling garments (pumped water loops, Apollo/Shuttle LCVG) for continuous duty. Heating side: aerogel insulation (0.013 W/m-K) plus carbon-fiber resistive zones on 7.4 V packs, 3-10 W per zone, with redundant thermal cutoffs. A 1 kg PCM vest at 250 W lasts ~12 minutes per 180 kJ/kg — the math is the product.

title: Floatable Material + Wind Glider + Parachute + Hood (Systems) — actual stuff
t: Floatable Material + Wind Glider + Parachute + Hood (Systems) — actual stuff
description: Actual-stuff edition — Floatable Material + Wind Glider + Parachute + Hood (Systems) — actual stuff. Floatable material is real: closed-cell EVA foam (0.1-0.3 g/cm3) displacing water per Archimedes — a 70 kg wearer needs ~70 L of displacement; ISO 12402 rates it in newtons. title: Lyrics vs actual stuff — how the two editions relate
t: Lyrics vs actual stuff — how the two editions relate
description: Actual-stuff edition — Lyrics vs actual stuff — how the two editions relate. Tracks: Edition guide · original lyrics and the actual-stuff edition side by side. Actual stuff: the relationship between the two editions. The original lyrics are Justin Addam Higgins' creative work, preserved verbatim and untouched — the vision, the verses, the JPLAG concept. The actual-stuff edition is the engineering companion: same track list, rewritten grounded in real materials and real specs. Where the lyrics dream (plasma amor, engine transportation, invisibility), the actual-stuff edition supplies the real reference (plasma tools, hover equations, signature management) and labels the dream as Signature concept. Neither edition replaces the other; together they are the album's vision and its verifiable companion.
